summary: Backend and LLM-workflow work on an AI hiring-automation product.
work: Built asynchronous Python and FastAPI workflows that run LLM calls through background workers, backed by PostgreSQL, Qdrant and Docker.
Integrated Groq, Google Gemini and OpenRouter behind one interface, with provider fallback, retries and structured outputs.
Contributed to a hiring-automation platform covering resume processing, semantic candidate matching, screening and automated interviews.
note: The code from this role is not public and is not linked here. My own Hiring Automation project is a separate repository and is not presented as company work.
